Ch129 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: harmonic analysis | ID: 12684

Statement

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every isometric solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Proof

Step 1. The algebraic operator \(P_{01290011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01290011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. By compactness of the nilpotent spectral family \(A_{01290012}\), the image is precompact in the Harnack space topology.

Step 3. The Hilbert-Schmidt functional \(\Phi_{01290013}\) on the Riemann surface satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01290013}\| \leq C_01290013\) by the Hilbert-Schmidt embedding theorem.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through linear approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
